description: Locks a path through the dos library and, when the lock succeeds, unlocks it again. It returns whether the lock succeeded.

name: find_string_index
description: Walks a table of 20-byte entries whose first field is a name string, comparing each name with the argument until one matches. It returns the matching index, or minus one when the table ends first.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:1BD8
name: unlink_and_free_list_entry
description: Searches a linked list for the entry matching a given block, unlinks it and frees its memory through the exec library. It decrements an entry count and returns the free result, or zero when the block was not found.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:1C1C
name: release_all_table_entries
description: Walks the table of 20-byte entries while each name is non-empty, freeing any attached memory block through the release routine. It then releases each of ten further slots that hold a value.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:1C94
name: search_string_table
description: Walks a table of 20-byte entries whose first field points to a name, comparing each name with the argument. It returns the index of the first match, or zero after the table ends.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:1CE0
name: sort_flagged_entries_by_attribute
description: Clears ten slots, then collects the indexes of table entries whose high flag bit is set together with their attribute bytes. It bubble-sorts the collected pairs by attribute value, processes each entry in that order, and releases both buffers at the end.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:1E74
name: process_input_event_queue
description: Walks a linked list of input events. Type-one events set or clear bits in a bitmap and may toggle state flags, while type-two events update state flags and append encoded entries to a ring buffer of sixteen slots.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:1E8A
name: process_input_event_list_tail
description: Processes the remaining events of an input event list with the same bitmap and ring-buffer logic, returning when the list ends.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:1EB8
name: drain_input_event_list
description: Walks an input event list, setting bitmap bits for each event code and recording flagged events into the ring buffer. Type-two events update state flags as they are read, and the routine returns when the list ends.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:1F26
name: scan_input_events_for_flags
description: Walks an input event list, applying type-two state updates and clearing or setting bitmap bits for type-one events. It records flagged events into the ring buffer until the list ends.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:1F50
name: process_remaining_input_events
description: Walks the remaining events of an input list, handling type-one bitmap updates and type-two state updates. It returns when the list ends.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:1F54
name: dispatch_input_event_codes
description: Handles a single input event code by setting or clearing state bits and flag bytes, then continues walking the event list with the same bitmap and ring-buffer updates.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:1F70
name: continue_input_event_walk
description: Continues walking the input event list from its current entry, applying the same bitmap and ring-buffer updates as the other event routines.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:1F74
name: apply_control_event_codes
description: Applies the control code in a register by setting or clearing state flags, then walks the rest of the event list, updating the bitmap and ring buffer.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:1F90
name: walk_input_events_with_codes
description: Walks input events, applying control-code flag updates and bitmap changes, and appends flagged events to the ring buffer when it has room.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:1FBA
name: append_event_to_ring_buffer
description: Appends an event entry to a ring buffer of sixteen slots when the buffer has room, then walks the remaining events and updates bitmap bits and flags.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2040
name: compute_ring_buffer_fill
description: Returns the difference between the write and read indices of a ring buffer, which gives the number of queued entries.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2052
name: poll_until_nonzero_word
description: Repeatedly calls a routine for a value and passes that value to another routine until the low word of the result is non-zero. It returns the combined result.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2074
name: poll_event_queue_with_wrap
description: Fetches an entry, passes it to a processing routine, and advances a ring-buffer index modulo sixteen when the low byte is zero. It returns the processed value once a non-zero word appears, or zero when no entry is available.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:208C
name: read_next_queued_event_word
description: Repeatedly fetches an entry from a helper and advances a ring-buffer index modulo sixteen when its low byte is zero. It returns the entry with its low byte cleared, or zero when the helper runs out of entries.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:20B2
name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately with no operations.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:20BA
name: loop_helpers_until_nonzero
description: Repeatedly calls a helper and then feeds its result to a second helper until the low word of the result is non-zero, and returns that value.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:20D8
name: loop_helpers_then_finish
description: Runs the same helper loop until the low word is non-zero, then makes one final helper call before returning the value.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:20F0
name: forward_single_call
description: Calls another routine and returns. It contains no other operations.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:212A
name: map_key_code_with_modifiers
description: Translates an input key code into a character value by looking it up in a table and adjusting a few specific codes. It then adds bits for modifier keys to the result, and a zero input returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2140
name: translate_key_code_via_library
description: Translates an input key code into a character value. Codes below a threshold are converted through a library call that fills a buffer, while the others use a lookup table, and modifier bits are then added to the result.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2194
name: translate_key_with_flag_bits
description: Looks up a key code in a table, adjusts a few specific values, and adds the modifier bits from a flag register. It returns the translated value.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:21CC
name: apply_modifier_bits_to_key
description: Adjusts a translated key value for shift-type flag bits and adds further modifier offsets when the value is non-zero. It then returns the adjusted value.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:21D8
name: apply_modifier_offsets
description: Adjusts a translated key value for one flag bit, then adds offsets for the remaining modifier bits when the value is non-zero. It returns the result.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:21E6
name: lookup_function_key_value
description: Maps a key code in a fixed range to a value, using a table lookup for one band and an offset for another, then adds modifier bits to a non-zero result.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:21FA
name: lookup_key_value_with_modifiers
description: Maps a key code through a table in one band and an offset in another, then adds modifier bits to any non-zero result and returns it.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2292
name: map_scancode_to_character
description: Converts a raw key code through a table to a character value, remaps four specific values, and then adds modifier bits for the qualifier flags. A zero argument returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:233C
name: dequeue_input_event
description: Under Forbid and Permit protection, removes the next entry from the ring buffer and returns it. When the buffer is empty it returns zero, and for two specific event codes it also stores a 32-bit payload in the state block.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:23CE
name: peek_next_queued_event
description: Returns the next queued entry without removing it from the ring buffer, or zero when the buffer is empty.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2484
name: read_file_into_memory_block
description: Checks available memory, allocates a block sized for a file record, and opens and reads the file through the dos library. It stores the block in a list slot and returns one on success, or zero when memory, opening or reading fails.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2568
name: free_all_list_entries
description: Walks a linked list of entries, releasing each entry's contents through a helper, and then clears the list head. It returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2590
name: set_default_mouse_pointer
description: Clears two pointer state globals and calls intuition library routines to set the mouse pointer. It returns nothing.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:25CA
name: clear_mouse_pointer
description: Calls one intuition library routine and then ClearPointer to remove the mouse pointer image.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:27E8
name: call_with_suppressed_field
description: Saves a 16-bit state field, clears it while calling another routine, restores the field and returns one. It protects a state flag around that call.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2AC4
name: run_text_dialog_until_confirm
description: Draws a text box with the given message, adds a numbered choice when the argument is zero or two, and waits in a loop for an input message until a confirming key arrives. It restores the saved window fields and returns one.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2C96
name: wait_for_disk_insert_prompt
description: Draws the insert-disk prompt text and waits in a loop for input messages until a confirming key is received. It then restores the saved window field and returns one.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2CDC
name: wait_for_confirm_key_input
description: Stores the current window field, waits for input messages until a confirming key is received, then restores the field and returns one.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2D5C
name: poll_input_until_confirm
description: Repeatedly reads input messages and returns once a confirming key is received, restoring the saved window field before it returns one.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2D64
name: restore_window_field_and_return
description: Unlocks a saved handle when one is set, restores a window field from a saved value, and returns one.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2E00
name: find_entry_by_name_chain
description: Searches a table of 20-byte entries for a name matching the argument, then follows the chain of linked indexes stored in the entry until it reaches one with no successor. It returns the final index and its stored value, or minus one when no name matches.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2E60
name: return_table_entry_value
description: Returns the 32-bit value stored in a table entry selected by a word index in a register. It performs no other work.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2E74
name: find_entry_by_name_register
description: Searches a table of 20-byte entries for a name matching the value held in a register, then follows the chain of linked indexes in the matching entry. It returns the final index and its stored value, or minus one when no name matches.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2E78
name: return_minus_one_status
description: Returns the value minus one with no other work. The routine is a stub that reports a fixed failure code.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2E80
name: shift_entry_position_fields
description: Subtracts the argument from one position field of the current entry record and adds scaled multiples of it to three other fields. The scale factors are minus eight, two and sixteen.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:2EE0
name: resolve_string_and_update_table
description: Resolves a named entry through a helper and copies its string into a local buffer, locking or opening the named file depending on the mode argument. It then stores the result in an entry of the global table and returns its index, or minus one when no slot can be found.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:3120
name: release_unused_table_entry
description: Looks up a table entry by name and, when no active slot refers to it, frees its memory block and clears its pointer. It returns one when the entry was released, otherwise zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:31C0
name: find_best_matching_entry_index
description: Scans the table of entries up to the first empty name and selects the index of an entry with a non-empty pointer whose threshold values fit the arguments, keeping the one with the smallest attribute byte. It returns that index, or zero when none qualifies.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:3254
name: close_installer_screens_and_libraries
description: Runs an optional callback, removes an interrupt server, then closes the window, screen and colour map resources and the libraries it opened. It returns the stored status of the last close.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:33A0
name: open_screen_window_and_libraries
description: Opens the exec, graphics and intuition resources it needs: it allocates per-frame buffers and bitmap planes, opens a custom screen and window, loads a palette, and adds an interrupt server. It returns zero when an allocation or open fails.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:384C
name: read_slot_block_from_file
description: Checks an entry slot and, when it is empty, first calls a helper to fill it. It then reads the slot's data from its file through the dos library.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:3930
name: compare_string_list
description: Iterates through a list of name strings, comparing each with the argument. It returns one when the matching entry has a non-zero pointer, and zero otherwise, including when no name matches.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:3994
name: forward_single_call
description: Calls another routine and returns. It contains no other operations.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:39AA
name: gather_planes_to_interleaved_bytes
description: Reads bytes from five planes spaced 8000 bytes apart and writes them interleaved into a single buffer, advancing along each row by a fixed stride. The loops cover a rectangle of columns and rows taken from the arguments.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 1 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Install EOB:0:3A00
name: set_current_font_from_record
description: Stores a font record in state fields, copies its size and style attributes, and calls the graphics library font function for each slot in use. It returns the offset of the first free slot, or zero when no record is supplied.
